theme.description: Premium, high-contrast dark theme with sharp, technical precision. Conveys authority, speed, and cutting-edge logistics. Avoids 'AI slop' by using aggressive asymmetry and avoiding generic gradients.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4. H1 MUST be `tracking-tighter`. Never center-align hero headings. Do NOT use Inter or Roboto.

body.usage: Use for all body text and paragraphs. `leading-relaxed`.

mono_accents.usage: Use for overlines, labels, metrics, button text, and tech stats. Always uppercase, `tracking-[0.2em]`, `text-xs`.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing using Tailwind scale: p-8, p-12, p-16, py-24, py-32. Container mx-auto px-6 md:px-12.
layouts.grid_system: Use 'The Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A - Tetris Grid)'. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8 or gap-12). Aggressive asymmetry.
layouts.alignment: Strictly left-aligned text for paragraphs and headings unless specific symmetry dictates otherwise.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' style for feature sections. Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px white/10 border. Avoid pure glassmorphism for heavy data, use solid dark charcoal.
visual_enhancers.gradients: No generic fullscreen gradients. Use subtle radial glows (blur-3xl) behind key elements. Maximum 20% gradient area.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) on the background to eliminate digital flatness.

motion.scroll: MUST use `lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling. It gives the site a premium feel.
motion.reveals: Kinetic Hero with on-load masked line-by-line reveal using `framer-motion` (`clip-path` or `overflow-hidden` trick).
motion.interactions: Hover states on cards: `-translate-y-2`, border shifts to brand primary, subtle box-shadow glow.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on product images and bento grid elements using Framer Motion.

components_instructions.hero: Kinetic Hero. Left-aligned massive heading in Clash Display. Masked line-by-line reveal. Subtitle in Manrope. CTA button in IBM Plex Mono. Incorporate subtle 3D/Parallax moment behind text.
components_instructions.marquee: The 'Kinetic Texture' marquee using `react-fast-marquee`. Massive outline text (`text-transparent stroke-white/20 stroke-1 text-8xl+`) reading 'IMPORTACIÓN • EXPORTACIÓN • LOGÍSTICA • ALMACENAMIENTO • CONSULTORÍA'.
components_instructions.services_bento: 4 to 5 cards in an asymmetric Bento grid. Each card has a dark surface, 1px border. Use icons/images. Overlines in Mono font.
components_instructions.products_showcase: Spotlight/clipped frames layout. 4 key products (Celulares, Consolas, Laptops, Smart TVs). Real photography. Use hover effects to clip or expand the frame.
components_instructions.about_stats: Large typographic stats (`text-6xl+` in Clash Display). Mono font for the metric label. High contrast.
components_instructions.contact_form: Visual, editorial contact form. Not a standard stacked layout. Use Shadcn Input/Textarea but styled heavily (flat, border-b only, dark background). Use 'The Tracing Beam' or subtle glow on focus.
components_instructions.header: Sticky nav. Solid dark background `#050505` with `border-b border-white/10`. Original SVG Logo Mark 'FERINFECTED CORP'. Links on desktop. No transparent backgrounds over content.

assets.icons: Use `@phosphor-icons/react` (Duotone weight) for high-end tech feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio against #050505 or #111111.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis (for smooth scrolling), react-fast-marquee, @phosphor-icons/react, lucide-react.
Do NOT use 'Inter' or 'Roboto' for any text.
Do NOT use pure #000000; use #050505 for background.
Implement the 'Kinetic Hero' with a masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion's `clip-path` or `overflow-hidden` trick on load.
Build a custom 'Bento grid' for the Servicios section following the 'Tetris' asymmetry rule. Do not just use a simple 2x2 grid.
Create a visually distinctive contact form, avoiding default Shadcn looks. Use bottom-borders only or highly stylized flat inputs with glow effects.
Translate all text into Spanish as requested by the user.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and links.
Ensure 'FERINFECTED CORP' has a distinct SVG logo mark used in the header and as a favicon.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
NEVER use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
